description: Hard-sign re-run of yesterday's MatmulMHL signed gate. Fork of exp497 recipe with gate_mode=signed and hard_sign_ste=true (forward uses hard +-1 signs -> integer ts; soft-sign gradient on backward). Gate: ts/(T_sel+|ts|) bounded rational gate. Tests whether a NON-exponential gate dodges the softmax temperature trap (exp500 softmax-hard=1.5437) and how close it gets to the argmax line (exp475=1.4962). Anchors: softmax-soft 1.4806, softmax-hard 1.5437, argmax 1.4962.
